---
title: Review a document-led form
subtitle: Native controls with rich context
form:
  version: 1
---

## The proposal

Keep reading context and explicit decisions in one document. Recommendations are
visible; no answer is chosen automatically.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Read context] --> B[Choose answers]
  B --> C[Validate and record]
```

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Document

Quarto supplies readable prose, code, comparisons, and diagrams.

### Collection

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Native controls] -->|JSON| B[Local receiver]
```
:::

```{ask}
id: direction
type: single_select
label: Which direction should proceed?
required: true
options:
  - value: native
    label: Quarto and native controls
    recommended: true
    detail: |
      Keep **structured answers** beside rich context.

      ```python
      result = collect_answers()
      ```
  - value: current
    label: Keep the current form
    description: Avoid adding a document compiler.
recommendation: Native controls fit longer technical reviews.
```

```{ask}
id: priorities
type: multi_select
label: What matters most?
min: 1
max: 3
options:
  - {value: clarity, label: Clarity, recommended: true}
  - {value: offline, label: Offline use}
  - {value: speed, label: Speed}
```

## Practical details

```{ask}
id: confidence
type: scale
label: How promising is the approach?
min: 1
max: 5
step: 1
recommended: 4
```

```{ask}
id: budget
type: number
label: Time budget
unit: minutes
min: 5
max: 120
step: 5
```

```{ask}
id: order
type: ranking
label: Order the priorities
options:
  - {value: clarity, label: Clarity}
  - {value: speed, label: Speed}
  - {value: flexibility, label: Flexibility}
```

```{ask}
id: title
type: short_text
label: Give the experiment a name
max_length: 80
```

```{ask}
id: reasoning
type: long_text
label: Explain the reasoning
placeholder: What works? What should change?
```

## Acceptance

```{ask}
id: fit
type: matrix
label: Where does the approach fit?
rows:
  - {value: quick, label: Quick decisions}
  - {value: detailed, label: Detailed reviews}
columns:
  - {value: "yes", label: Good fit}
  - {value: maybe, label: Maybe}
  - {value: poor, label: Poor fit}
```

```{ask}
id: review
type: review
label: Review the direction
items:
  - id: renderer
    label: Use Quarto for rich context
    recommended: approve
  - id: archive
    label: Keep one decision archive
    recommended: approve
    detail: |
      The Markdown transcript and its companion bundle stay together.
```
